transcript.text: dryer drum wont turn but i can here it running, hotpiont. clothes just sit there

From what you have described, the most likely cause is drive belt. With the dryer unplugged and empty, turn the drum slowly by hand. Does it turn normally, does it feel stiff or stuck, or does it spin round very easily with no resistance at all?
it spins really easy with almost no resistance
Run a short programme with a normal load. Is the drum turning now, or still not?

still not turning, motor hums and air blows but drum just sits there. i did hear a twang/thud yesterday mid cycle and a slight rubber smell at the time. also can see a black rubbery strip at the bottom through the filter slot with a torch

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't run it again — not even as a test — until it has been checked by a qualified engineer. The checks point to the drive belt. To find the right part, could you give me the model number? It is usually on a sticker inside the door opening.
